description: Build a synthetic-safe interactive projection mapping rig for a USB webcam plus projector: camera/synthetic/existing TOP input, frame-difference motion field, placeholder blob/post-it mask, cyan dot and magenta card visual TOPs, manual Corner Pin projection mapping, debug switch, live controls, and an out1 Null TOP. Defaults to source='camera' for installations, but source='synthetic' previews without camera permission. Returns output/debug paths and explicit warnings for camera, blob tracking, and physical calibration states.

analysis_resolution.description: Square working resolution for cheap motion/blob analysis.

blob_threshold.description: Threshold used by the placeholder blob/post-it mask branch.

camera_index.description: USB/webcam device index used when source='camera'.

card_count.description: Target count for magenta card blocks. This MVP uses it as visual density metadata.

debug_view.description: Which branch the debug switch shows initially.

existing_top_path.description: Absolute TOP path required when source='existing_top'.

expose_controls.description: Expose live controls for calibration/debug/performance tuning.

fallback_to_synthetic.description: If camera creation fails, build a synthetic source so the rig remains previewable.

interaction_mode.description: Interaction branch to prioritize. The first slice always keeps motion available.

max_blobs.description: Maximum blob slots reserved for the later marker-tracking branch.

motion_sensitivity.description: Gain over the frame-difference motion field.

name.description: Name for the generated interactive projection mapping Base COMP.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP where the interactive projection mapping system is created.

particle_count.description: Target count for the cyan dot field. This MVP uses it as visual density metadata.

projection_brightness.description: Final Level TOP brightness before out1.

repel_radius.description: Normalized radius metadata for hand/motion repulsion.

source.description: Input source: a USB camera, a self-animated synthetic TOP, or an existing TOP pulled through a Select TOP.

name: create_interactive_projection_mapping
title: Create interactive projection mapping
